tools.name: unreal_psk_import
tools.description: Import: Import a PSK file. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.

vertex_color_space.description: The source vertex color space (items depend on the scene)

should_import_vertex_normals.description:
Import vertex normals, if available.

This is only supported for PSKX files

should_import_extra_uvs.description: Import extra UV maps, if available

components.description: Which components to import (items depend on the scene)

should_import_shape_keys.description:
Import shape keys, if available.

This is only supported for PSKX files

tools.name: unreal_psa_import_all
tools.description: Import PSA: Import all sequences from the selected PSA file. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.

should_use_fake_user.description: Assign each imported action a fake user so that the data block is saved even it has no users

should_use_config_file.description: Use the .config file that is sometimes generated when the PSA file is exported from UEViewer. This file contains options that can be used to filter out certain bones tracks from the imported actions

should_stash.description: Stash each imported action as a strip on a new non-contributing NLA track

should_overwrite.description: If an action with a matching name already exists, the existing action will have it's data overwritten instead of a new action being created

should_write_metadata.description: Additional data will be written to the custom properties of the Action (e.g., frame rate)

should_convert_to_samples.description: Convert keyframes to read-only samples. Recommended if you do not plan on editing the actions directly

fps_source.description: FPS Source (items depend on the scene)

fps_custom.description: The frame rate to which the imported sequences will be resampled to

compression_ratio_source.description: Compression Ratio Source (items depend on the scene)

compression_ratio_custom.description: The compression ratio to apply to the imported sequences

translation_scale.description: Scale factor for bone translation values. Use this when the scale of the armature does not match the PSA file

filepath.description: File path used for importing the PSA file

tools.name: unreal_psk_export
tools.description: Export: Export selected meshes to PSK. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.

tools.name: unreal_psa_export
tools.description: Export: Export actions to PSA. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.
